verdict.rationale: Rippling's own global-payroll docs say it pays both employees and contractors in a single system, which covers the core of the story. The docs never mention W-2 or 1099 classification and never describe how contractor payments or year-end 1099 filing work, so coverage is partial. Missing for 10: explicit W-2 vs 1099 worker-type handling, documented 1099 contractor payment and 1099 tax-form generation and filing, independent or hands-on corroboration of mixed employee and contractor pay runs.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can pay both W-2 employees and 1099 contractors from one platform
